name: Ascent Watch: Meridian Edition
description: A cheerfully produced weekly magazine show funded by the Axiom Corporate Residential Division, profiling Tier 2 and Tier 3 residents who have 'earned' small quality-of-life upgrades through loyalty point accumulation and voluntary productivity enrollment. Hosts Preethi Dlamini-Sandoval and Cael Novotný-Mbeki deliver every segment with warm, unrehearsed-seeming enthusiasm, and the show never once uses the word 'debt.' The production values are exceptional — warm lighting, natural textures, the quiet suggestion that comfort is available to anyone willing to work for it.
cultural_impact: The show's loyalty-point framing quietly normalized the term 'earned comfort,' which became standard language in Axiom residential contracts by 2201.
story_hooks: A runner crew is hired to intercept the leaked compliance memo before it reaches a pirate broadcaster.
One of the NDА-signing participants wants out — and has footage they weren't supposed to keep.
The warm, likable co-host Cael Novotný-Mbeki has been quietly funneling show location data to a Shelf mutual aid network.
